scheme.name: Moldova vignette (vinieta), trucks not registered in Moldova

dataset.method: Codul fiscal, Titlul IX (taxele rutiere), Anexa nr. 2, item 4: the charge for using Moldova's roads by vehicles not registered in Moldova, trucks and road tractors by total mass: over 3.5 t up to 10 t EUR 8 a day (32 for 7 days, 640 for 12 months), over 10 t up to 40 t EUR 11 a day (55 for 7 days, 1120 for 12 months). The table keeps the 1-day amount; trucks registered in Moldova pay instead a yearly road fee, not modelled. The page gives no date: valid_from is the day it was first read.

sources.title: e-Vinieta (S.A. Administrația Națională a Drumurilor): Legislația

tax.note: carbon-cost states the tax basis in each table's text (dataset.method), not as a field.
